name: Perspective-Correct 3D Gaussian Splatting via Plücker Coordinates
definition: A differentiable method for evaluating 3D Gaussians along per-pixel viewing rays that avoids matrix inversion, ensuring numerical stability and eliminating special handling for degenerate splats.
summary: Perspective-Correct 3D Gaussian Splatting via Plücker Coordinates is a differentiable, matrix-inversion-free method that ensures numerical stability and perspective-correct rendering by using Plücker coordinates to evaluate Gaussian splats along viewing rays.
